frozen_model.map: T=b(q)+n*(a^rho*v_rho), with fixed H-null n and constant a^rho
frozen_model.comparison: off shell modulo divergence of an explicit first-jet current
frozen_model.scope_exclusion: rotating null lines and the full velocity-space Frobenius classification

variational_result.verdict: the fixed-null-line shear always closes its linear acceleration term modulo a first-jet divergence

quadratic_potential.definition: P(T)=(1/2)T^T M T for real symmetric M
quadratic_potential.expansion: P(b+n*psi)=(1/2)b^T M b+psi*n^T M b+(1/2)psi^2*n^T M n
quadratic_potential.velocity_independence_iff: n^T M n=0 and n^T M b(q)=0 for every q
quadratic_potential.mass_control: for M=m^2 H with m^2 nonzero in signature (1,1), velocity independence forces b(q) in span(n)
quadratic_potential.mass_control_consequence: the pulled-back kinetic density then vanishes identically
quadratic_potential.ceiling: control-model no-go only, not a source or GU no-go

controls.constant_cross_pairing: n=(1,1), m=(1,-1), b=m*q gives c=2 and makes the acceleration term a pure divergence
controls.nonconstant_curve: b(q)=(q,q^2) gives c=1-2q and a genuine first-order correction 2*(a.v)*X
controls.massive_detection: M=m^2 H and b=m*q produce the nonzero velocity term 2*m^2*q*psi
controls.positive_metric: a positive carrier form has no nonzero real null n

claim_ceiling: exact repository-owned fixed-null-line variational and quadratic-potential classification only; no source-owned full carrier, rotating-null-line theorem, gauge quotient, analytic domain or physical equivalence
source_attribution: the source owns none of the frozen carrier, map, kinetic or potential controls
next_condition: classify rotating-null-line C2 solutions and Helmholtz equations or obtain the source-owned full principal symbol, gauge complex and analytic domain
